name: 標誌欄＋數欄連結群組＋分隔線＋底部列
desc: 上半部是標誌加數欄連結群組並排，下方以橫跨畫面的分隔線隔出底部列，底部列一側是小型下拉選單、另一側是一行小字。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的頁尾，放在頁面最下方，跟著頁面捲動。頁尾上緣有一條橫跨整個畫面寬的分隔線。內容分成數欄並排的連結群組，對齊頁面內容寬度、各欄靠上對齊：最左一欄是標誌，其餘每欄是一個小標題加上直向排列的文字連結，各欄寬度大致相等。下方是底部列，上方有一條橫跨整個畫面寬、貼齊畫面左右邊緣的分隔線：一側可放小型下拉選單，沒有時省略，另一側是一行小字。
mobile: 改為單欄由上往下排列：標誌置中放在最上方；連結群組改為直向堆疊，全部展開，靠左對齊。頁尾上緣與底部列上方的分隔線都保留，橫跨畫面寬。底部列改成上下兩行並置中：小型下拉選單在上，一行小字在下。沒有動態效果。

en.name: Logo column + link group columns + divider + bottom bar
en.desc: A logo and several columns of link groups side by side on top, with a full-width divider separating a bottom bar that holds a small dropdown on one side and a line of small text on the other.
en.prompt: Create a footer whose height is determined by its content, placed at the very end of the page and scrolling with it. A divider spanning the full viewport width runs along the top edge of the footer. The content is split into several side-by-side columns of link groups, aligned to the page content width, with all columns top-aligned: the leftmost column holds the logo, and each remaining column is a group heading with text links stacked vertically below it; the columns are roughly equal in width. Below them is the bottom bar, with a divider above it spanning the full viewport width, flush with the left and right edges of the viewport: optionally place a small dropdown on one side, omitting it when there is no content, and a line of small text on the other side.
en.mobile: Everything becomes a single column stacked top to bottom: the logo is centered at the top; the link groups become a vertical stack, all expanded and left-aligned. Both the divider along the top edge and the divider above the bottom bar are kept and span the full viewport width. The bottom bar becomes two stacked lines, centered: the small dropdown on top and the line of small text below. There is no motion.
